articles.title: FC Raengdai Secure Top Spot In Durand Cup Group D With Thrilling Win
articles.summary: Debutant FC Raengdai has made a significant impact in the prestigious Durand Cup, securing the top position in Group D. They achieved this after a thrilling 4-3 victory against TRAU FC, a match made memorable by a spectacular hat-trick from Mridul Dole. This strong performance highlights their competitive spirit in India's national football tournament.

articles.title: Centre to explain NEET question paper security process to Supreme Court
articles.summary: The Centre plans to demonstrate before the Supreme Court the rigorous process and safeguards implemented for the NEET question paper, from printing to distribution. This move aims to assure the court of the examination system's integrity amid ongoing scrutiny, emphasizing the government's commitment to transparency in national educational assessments.

articles.title: GRSE expands non-defense portfolio with ONGC contract for 4 vessels
articles.summary: Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers Ltd (GRSE), a defence PSU, has secured a significant contract from Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC). This strategic move diversifies GRSE's construction portfolio beyond traditional military projects, showcasing its expansion into new sectors and leveraging engineering expertise for the oil and gas industry.

articles.title: “The Zelensky Curse” Revisited, and Its Ultimate Victims
articles.summary: Following the Ukraine conflict, Duran editor Alex Christoforou originated a viral meme that became strongly identified with portraying the Kyiv government as 'Neo-Nazi.' This highlights the significant role of information warfare and narrative shaping in international conflicts, influencing public perception globally. For SSB aspirants, understanding such propaganda tactics and their impact on geopolitical events is crucial.

articles.title: Kara Robinson Chamberlain To Host True-Crime Series For Freeform From Ample
articles.summary: Freeform, a Disney-owned network, has greenlit a new true-crime series, 'Somebody Knows Something.' The show will focus on unsolved missing persons cases, seeking to generate public interest and potential new leads. Hosted by a true-crime influencer, this venture marks Freeform's return to the popular genre, aiming to engage viewers in resolving real-life mysteries.

articles.title: RIMPAC 2026 comes to a successful conclusion
articles.summary: The Rim of the Pacific (RIMPAC) exercise, the world's largest biennial combined and joint maritime drill, successfully concluded near Hawaii. Led by the US Navy, RIMPAC brings together numerous nations to enhance interoperability, strengthen partnerships, and demonstrate collective readiness across a full spectrum of naval operations. This massive multi-national exercise is crucial for maintaining regional stability and advancing maritime security cooperation among participating defence forces.
